concerns.text: FR-005 (motion control) and SC-001 (success rate) lack complete task coverage. T015 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and T015a/T017 depend on it. The spec requires motion exclusion logic and success rate calculation to be implemented; the current task state leaves these critical path items unimplemented.

FR-004 (collapsing metrics) and FR-003 (entropy/SD calculation) are not fully covered. T023 (aggregation logic) and T026 (saving metrics.csv) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these, the core predictor variable cannot be generated for US-2.

FR-005 (regression) and FR-006 (permutation test) are unsupported. T030, T031, and T036 are marked [ ] (incomplete). These tasks are required to perform the statistical association and significance testing mandated by the spec.

SC-003 (permutation significance) and the 6-hour performance constraint lack verification tasks. T039b (benchmark script) and T039c (verification) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires the pipeline to process 1200 subjects within 6 hours; this constraint is not covered by completed tasks.

T024 is tagged for FR-008 but implements 'phase-shuffled surrogates'. The Plan (Constitution Check) and Complexity Tracking explicitly mandate an 'AR-based surrogate null model' because phase-shuffling is deemed statistically invalid. This is a stale tag referencing a design that was rejected in the plan.

T003 (linting configuration) is marked [X] (complete) but the Plan's 'Re-plan' section states no configuration files exist. This is a false completion status that does not match the actual repository state.
